notes.title: Friday - 2023 03 February
notes.notes:
New Features:
- Whole New looks: Completely Redesigned menu UIs for a more immersive and smoother experience
- New In-Game UIs to deliver a better and realistic experience of WWII 
- New in-game Economy: reward types are reworked to create a progress driven experience
- Fast Running! get to different tactical positions on the battlefield fast and efficiently.
- Daily Missions: complete missions each day to claim exciting rewards 
- Level Reward Path: now with every new Level you reach tons of new and exciting rewards and features are waiting for you to be claimed.
- New Weapons Upgrade System: now you can earn the resources you need for upgrading your weapons, much faster than before.
- Mission Briefs: before every match, your mission targets are briefed to you.
- New Game Modes: introducing three type of different game modes 
- Newly Added Tutorial and Improved Onboarding
- Added Mini Map feature 

Improvments:
- Reworked many parts of the Gameplay for smoother and better gameplay
- Major Changes to shooting mechanics, feelings and visual effects to improve experience and balance
- Improved Networking and server connectivity
- Better Tank and AirPlane Controll
- Whole new airplane gameplay and aerial fight experience
- New and improved game play UIs for a better experience
- Better Sensitivity Control
- Many major bug fixes and improvements
